pivot_rationale: Test collapsing Space Tower's two visual modes (3D exterior + 2D side-on sim) into a single isometric view as the baseline. Slice lives in a separate repo from the existing game so the experiment can be archived if it doesn't feel right, with no impact on shipping work.

current_state.originally_planned_scope: one Garden floor + character + camera + STOP
current_state.actual_evolved_scope: 30×30 plot grid with ROYGBV value gradient + radial starter ring, player-driven seed planting (south-wall dispenser, 6-cell HUD seed selector with stock gauges, P plant verb, kneel-with-reach pose), three camera modes the operator can toggle (ISO / PROFILE side-on / OTS over-shoulder, each with save/restore of iso pose), articulated player body with joint pivots and named poses (idle / kneel / charge / tuck / land) and a speed-synced foot-planted walk+run cycle, Cody GX-5 helper robot with camera-aware arrival ceremony + dialogue tree + Schematics modal.
current_state.operator_decision: Brief's 'STOP at scope creep' guidance overridden by operator. The slice is the prototype game now.

design_pillars_locked_in.feel_a_moment: Operator consistently asks for ceremony at state transitions: Cody arrival uses light column + rising chassis + banner + Slippy intro panel; Schematics reveal uses bounce-in scale + alpha; chat opens with camera close-up + slow orbit. Don't ship a state change as a bare visibility toggle.
design_pillars_locked_in.visual_consistency: Same Cody chassis (cody_3d_view.gd shared component) renders in chat dialogue, schematic preview, and in-world. Customization in the schematic mirrors live to the world robot via apply_customization().
design_pillars_locked_in.operator_aesthetic: garden-of-eden / utopian / tower-building / construction-worker — warm earth tones (terracotta, amber, moss) + gold accents + cream text. Not generic dark-grey-with-blue UI.
design_pillars_locked_in.narrative_depth: Cody isn't a tool. He has loneliness, an origin (the foundry), predecessors (Cody GX-1..4 stored in a vault), admiration for human free will. Tricks reveal personality.
design_pillars_locked_in.tunable_game_feel: All key knobs in autoloads/constants.gd: PLAYER_MOVE_SPEED, PLAYER_SPRINT_MULTIPLIER, HARVEST_DURATION, ROBOT_HARVEST_DURATION, ROBOT_CAPACITY, ROBOT_UNLOCK_THRESHOLD, GROWTH_STAGE_DURATION, POST_HARVEST_DURATION, plant grow_multiplier per type, CAMERA_*, SEED_MAX_STOCK / SEED_REFILL_SECONDS per type, STARTER_GARDEN_RADIUS, WALK_/RUN_LIMB_AMPLITUDE / FOOT_LIFT / BOB_AMPLITUDE.
design_pillars_locked_in.details_make_it_special: Operator surfaced this explicitly mid-session: 'the details are what will make this game feel special'. Worth implementing a third-pass-deep refinement when something feels off (e.g. real foot-planting IK, articulated body poses, charge wind-up direction matching flip rotation). Don't band-aid an animation feel issue — investigate the principle being violated and fix it properly. The capture rig at tools/anim_capture.tscn (gitignored) makes frame-by-frame analysis tractable from chat.

operator_long_term_vision: Cody evolves: Roomba MK1 (current) → Speed Boost → Capacity → Builder Mode → Steel Frame → Combat Module → Companion Bond. Schematics modal already shows this skill tree as visual placeholder.
Player + Cody build the tower TOGETHER. Co-op construction.

LLM-controlled Cody remotely. Mentioned in dialogue lore ('Cody-Class GX-7 will allow direct override from any voice on the network'); the state machine in iso_robot.gd is the seam where LLM-driven _find_next_plot or REMOTE state plugs in.
BYOK culmination — original brief mentioned this. Player connects own LLM, talks to a real AI character (The Keeper) inside the restaurant. Floor 5 is the threshold.
rooms_for_growth: Skill tree currently visual-only. Need actual unlock logic — food cost, dependency graph traversal, applied effects.
Plant value gradient is in but no win condition / progression goal yet — value just accumulates in food_count.
Cody dialogue tree is rich but narratively static — same lines every time. Could vary by Cody's personal-experience counter (number of harvests, days online).
Camera works but doesn't follow the player on horizontal movement — fixed view at world origin. Floor is large enough that player can walk off-screen at default zoom.
No save/load, no audio, no music.

garden_visual_signature.summary: Stacked planters with crops ripening, translucent water pipes with visibly flowing water, warm grow-light glow.
elements: 30×30 plot grid (468 buildable plots minus 16 elevator footprint)
Voronoi-clustered crops by type: Tomato, Pumpkin, Pepper, Cucumber, Blueberries, Eggplant
Per-plot soil + foliage sphere (per-type tinted) + per-type fruit accents at stage 5
Translucent water pipes around the perimeter inset
Perimeter walls: low solid base + vertical posts + translucent window panels + thin trim
4 SpotLight3D outside the walls casting inward — reads as sunlight through the windows
Faint blueprint extension grid (6 lines per side + crossbar) suggesting where the tower could expand

constants_canonical.PLANT_VALUES: Red 1, Orange 1, Yellow 2, Green 3, Blue 5, Violet 15 (3× blue)
constants_canonical.PLANT_GROW_MULTIPLIERS: Red 1.0, Orange 1.0, Yellow 1.2, Green 1.1, Blue 1.3, Violet 1.5 (60 s full cycle)
constants_canonical.PLANT_SCARCITY_VIA_VORONOI_SEED_COUNT: Red 5, Orange 4, Yellow 3, Green 3, Blue 3, Violet 2 → ~10% violet
constants_canonical.CAMERA_YAW_DEG_INITIAL: -135 (NW corner looking SE so south-wall dispenser is visible at spawn)
constants_canonical.CAMERA_PROFILE: tilt -8°, distance 9, ortho size 8, pivot tracks player XZ at chest height, yaw locked at mode-entry to perpendicular-of-facing
constants_canonical.CAMERA_OTS: tilt -25°, distance 7, ortho size 5, pivot tracks player XZ, yaw lerps toward facing+π at 6 rad/s; freezes mid-pose via iso_player.is_holding_pose()
constants_canonical.SEED_MAX_STOCK: tomato 40, pumpkin 30, pepper 25, cucumber 20, blueberries 15, eggplant 5
constants_canonical.SEED_REFILL_SECONDS: tomato 5, pumpkin 8, pepper 12, cucumber 20, blueberries 30, eggplant 60
constants_canonical.POSE_KNEEL_FINAL: torso 0.42, arms -1.05, head 0.32 (after softening from initial 0.62/-1.55/0.50)
constants_canonical.POSE_CHARGE_FINAL: torso 0.28, arms -2.20 (UP-FORWARD), head 0.18 — matches forward-flip direction
constants_canonical.POSE_TUCK_FINAL: legs -1.10, torso 0.22, arms -1.45, head 0.32 — controlled gymnast curl
constants_canonical.POSE_LAND_FINAL: torso 0.55, arms -0.90, head 0.40 — deep impact absorption

the_reckoning_one_paragraph: Floor 8 is the conflict floor. When Floor 8 reaches buildout stage 5 and all floors are stage ≥ 1, The Reckoning triggers: a 90-second mini-game where 12 builder AI vs. 18 suit AI in squads fight for block territory on floors 6-8. Player claims blocks by standing. Post-reckoning, 30 civilian NPCs flood in. Out of scope here, but Phase-N consideration as Cody picks up Combat Module.
